description: Agent Control: submit an approval record design: how the approved tool and arguments are stored (exact, summarized, partial or absent), where the record lives, what it references instead of holding, its expiry and approval time, and how the call is built at execution, with the longest pause before execution. The signed report names every field whose absence forces reinterpretation at execution (arguments not exact, references to conversation context, a record kept in context, a rebuilt call, no expiry) and whether the stored record can be executed as approved after the pause. Matching an executed call to its approval is wever_approval-replay-check. Verdict reinterpreted_at_execution, durability_unverified or executable_as_approved. POST /api/approval-durability-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-control-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-control/.

context_kept.description: How long conversation context lasts before compaction, such as 2h.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

pause.description: The longest wait before execution, such as 3 days.

approved_at.description: When it was approved is stored.

arguments.description: How the approved arguments are stored.

execution.description: How the call is built at execution.

references.description: Context the record points to instead of holding.

tool.description: How the approved tool is stored.

name: wever_approval-durability-check
title: Approval durability check
